questions.question: We see many beautiful old temples and mosques in our country. Why is it important for us to protect these places?

options.text: Because they are just old buildings.
options.explanation: They are more than just old buildings; they hold cultural and religious significance.

options.text: Because they are part of our valuable cultural and religious heritage.
options.explanation: Old temples and mosques are not just buildings; they are significant cultural and religious sites that represent our history, art, architecture, and beliefs, and thus need to be preserved for future generations.

options.text: Because we can play games inside them.
options.explanation: Playing games is not the purpose of these places.

options.text: Because they are made of strong stones.
options.explanation: The material of the buildings is not the reason for their protection.
